agency:frsrecruitment.com:assistant-qual.title: Assistant Quality  Manager
agency:frsrecruitment.com:assistant-qual.description:
Assistant Quality Manager    
   West Cork,  | €50,000–€60,000 DOE + Bonus + Pension   
    Please note: This position is open to candidates who already have the legal right to work in Ireland. Visa sponsorship or work permit support is not available for this position.    
  A well-established food manufacturing operation in West Cork is seeking an experienced Food QA professional to join its technical team and provide additional support and leadership across its operation.  
  This is a newly created position and not a replacement role and has come about due to site expansion.  You will work closely with the existing Technical Manager, supporting the continued development of the quality function and taking ownership of key quality systems, food safety and assurance activities.  
  The role is hands-on and factory-floor focused, with responsibility for ensuring high standards of food safety, product quality, GMP, HACCP, auditing and continuous improvement.  
   Key Responsibilities   
 
  Support the day-to-day implementation and monitoring of the  Plant HACCP plan.  
  Drive and promote a strong food safety and quality culture through coaching and mentoring of production teams.  
  Maintain the Quality Management System in an audit-ready state.  
  Ensure product quality standards are maintained from raw material receipt through processing, storage and dispatch.  
  Manage microbiological testing, including environmental swabbing, cleaning validation and shelf-life testing.  
  Work closely with Production to ensure adherence to quality procedures, GMP and 5S standards.  
  Conduct root cause analysis, identify corrective actions and ensure effective implementation.  
  Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives across the operation.  
  Support internal and external accreditation audits.  
 
   Skills & Experience   
  The successful candidate will ideally have:  
 
  A Food Science or relevant third-level qualification.  
  Proven experience in a similar Quality/Technical role within a BRC-accredited food manufacturing environment.  
  Strong working knowledge of HACCP, GMP, food safety and quality systems.  
  Experience preparing for and supporting BRC and other accreditation audits.  
  Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.  
  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coach and develop production teams.  
  The ability to build effective relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.  
 
   Package   
 
  Salary: €50,000–€60,000 DOE  
  Discretionary  Bonus scheme after 12 months, subject to performance and eligibility  
  5% pension  
  Opportunity to take on a key role within an established and growing food manufacturing operation  
 
     
   Please note: This position is open to candidates who already have the legal right to work in Ireland. Visa sponsorship or work permit support is not available for this position.

agency:frsrecruitment.com:business-devel.title: Business Development Manager
agency:frsrecruitment.com:business-devel.description:
Business Development Manager      
  Our client is seeking a commercially driven, new-business-focused Business Development Manager to accelerate growth across the property sector.     
  This is a genuine hunter role, suited to someone who enjoys identifying opportunities, building relationships from the ground up and converting prospects into long-term commercial partnerships.     
  You will be responsible for developing new business with property developers, landlords, property owners, investment groups and organisations managing residential or commercial property portfolios.      
  The focus will be on identifying decision-makers, understanding their requirements and presenting the solution as a commercially attractive proposition.     
  You will combine strong sales instincts with sufficient technical understanding to engage confidently with customers, explain the benefits of a solution and manage a consultative sales process.     
  This is an opportunity to develop a new market, build a substantial pipeline and turn individual customer wins into longer-term portfolio opportunities.     
   Key Responsibilities      
 
  Proactively identify, research and target new business opportunities across the property sector.     
  Develop and execute a structured business development strategy to generate new leads, secure meetings and convert prospects into customers.     
  Build and maintain a targeted pipeline of prospective clients, prioritising opportunities with strong commercial potential.     
  Develop an understanding of customers’ operational requirements, commercial objectives and investment considerations.     
  Identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships across additional sites, developments or property portfolios.     
  Develop a strong understanding of the technology, installation process, platform and associated services.     
  Translate technical information into clear commercial benefits for customers.     
  Achieve agreed new business, revenue and pipeline targets.     
  Maintain accurate CRM records, sales forecasts and regular pipeline reporting.     
  Work collaboratively with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition from winning new business to delivering the agreed solution.     
 
  We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded salesperson who is motivated by winning new business and building a market.     
 
  Proven experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong emphasis on new business acquisition.     
  A demonstrable track record of identifying opportunities, opening doors and converting prospects into paying customers.     
  Experience managing a consultative sales process involving multiple stakeholders and potentially longer sales cycles.     
  Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.     
  Full clean driving licence and willingness to travel to meet customers.

agency:frsrecruitment.com:child-youth-co.title: Child & Youth Coordinator
agency:frsrecruitment.com:child-youth-co.description:
FRS Recruitment in Partnership with Aoibhneas 
  Role:  Child & Youth Coordinator 
  Contract:  Full-Time (39h pw) & Permanent 
  Salary:  €68,754 per annum 
  Location:  North Dublin Based 
   
 The Child & Youth Coordinator will oversee the delivery, development and quality assurance of Aoibhneas' Child and Youth Services. Providing leadership, supervision and strategic direction to the Child and Youth Team, while ensuring compliance with safeguarding, legislative and organisational requirements. The successful candidate will have a key part in strengthening outcomes for children and young people through effective service delivery, partnership working and programme development. 
   
 Working hours generally cover five days per week, Monday to Friday, between 9.00am and 6.00pm. Some evening work, on-call duties and occasional out-of-hours commitments may be required. Flexibility required to locations due to the nature of the service.  
   
  Key Responsibilities:  
 
 Leadership and Staffing 
 Service Provision 
 Safeguarding and Quality Assurance 
 Stakeholder Engagement and Community Partnerships 
 Administration 
 
   
  Essential Requirements:  
 
 Third Level Qualification at degree level in Social Care, Social Work, Youth Work, Psychology, Child and Family Studies or a related discipline. 
 Minimum of five years' relevant experience working with children, young people and families in a social care, family support, youth work or domestic abuse setting. 
 Minimum of three years' experience in a supervisory, coordination or leadership role. 
 Excellent knowledge and understanding of domestic abuse and its impact on children and young people. 
 Excellent knowledge and understanding of Children's First legislation and safeguarding practice. 
 Strong skills in case management, risk assessment, decision-making and inter-agency working. 
 Experience developing, implementing and evaluating programmes for children and young people. 
 Excellent communication, facilitation, leadership and team-building skills. 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including report writing and data analysis. 
 
   
  Desirable Criteria:  
 
 Postgraduate qualification in a relevant field. 
 Experience managing multidisciplinary teams. 
 Experience securing and managing funded service delivery programmes. 
 Access to own transport. 
 
   
  Benefits:  
 
 Employer Pension Contribution of 5%. 
 Annual leave 22 days inclusive of 2 well-being days with incremental days in line with service. 
 Access to Digital GP Care and other benefits. 
 Access to External Supervision and Employee Assistance Programme. 
 
   
  All offers of employment with Aoibhneas are subject to Garda Vetting, satisfactory reference checks and verification of legal eligibility to work in Ireland. Aoibhneas is an equal opportunities employer. A Panel may be formed out of this recruitment process.

agency:frsrecruitment.com:commercial-cli.title: Commercial Client Executive
agency:frsrecruitment.com:commercial-cli.description:
The Role  
 My client, a well-established and highly regarded commercial insurance broker based in Cavan, is looking to appoint a Commercial Client Executive to join their friendly, close-knit and client-focused team. 
   
 This is a full-time, permanent hybrid position offering the opportunity to manage and develop a portfolio of commercial clients, with a strong focus on renewals, client servicing and new business. 
   
 This role would suit an experienced Commercial Insurance professional who enjoys building strong client relationships, understands the Irish insurance market and is looking for a role where they can take ownership of their clients and develop their career within a well-established brokerage. 
   
  Tasks & Duties  
 
 Managing and servicing a portfolio of commercial insurance clients 
 Advising clients across a range of commercial insurance products 
 Managing the full renewal process, from reviewing client requirements through to negotiating terms and securing appropriate cover 
 Handling policy adjustments, mid-term amendments and day-to-day client queries 
 Developing strong, long-term relationships with clients, insurers and colleagues 
 Identifying opportunities to develop existing client relationships and generate new business 
 Using your existing market knowledge and insurer relationships to deliver the right solutions for clients 
 Preparing and processing insurance documentation accurately and efficiently 
 Ensuring all activity is carried out in line with company procedures and relevant regulatory requirements, including Central Bank of Ireland regulations 
 Working collaboratively with colleagues to deliver a high standard of client service 
 
   
   
  Experience, Knowledge & Qualifications  
 
 Previous experience within Commercial Insurance is essential 
 Insurance broking experience is highly desirable 
 Experience managing or servicing a commercial book of business would be an advantage 
 CIP / APA qualified, or Grandfathered status 
 Good knowledge of the Irish commercial insurance market 
 Strong client relationship and communication skills 
 Excellent telephone manner and confidence dealing with clients and insurers 
 Highly organised with strong attention to detail 
 Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and use your own initiative 
 Comfortable working as part of a close-knit team 
 A genuine interest in developing a long-term career within the insurance broking sector 
 
   
   
 For further information please contact Sabrina at FRS Recruitment

agency:frsrecruitment.com:commercial-ins.title: Commercial Insurance Account Executive
agency:frsrecruitment.com:commercial-ins.description:
Commercial Account Executive  
  Location:  Thurles, Co Tipperary 
  Our client, a busy and growing locally owned Insurance Broker based in Thurles, Co Tipperary, are offering an exciting opportunity to an enthusiastic individual who wishes to develop their career in commercial insurance.  This is a progressive, forward thinking company who value all their staff and are committed to providing an inclusive and enjoyable working environment.  
   
  The Opportunity  
 Due to continued growth, they are seeking an experienced Commercial Account Executive to join their expanding Commercial team.  This is an excellent opportunity to join a close-knit, customer-focused brokerage where you'll manage a diverse portfolio of SME commercial clients, build long-term relationships and play an integral role in the continued success of the business. 
  Key Responsibilities  
 
 Manage a portfolio of SME commercial clients across a broad range of industries. 
 Handle new business, renewals and mid-term adjustments from initial enquiry through to policy placement. 
 Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients by providing expert insurance advice and exceptional customer service. 
 Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling. 
 Negotiate competitive terms and cover with insurers to achieve the best outcome for clients. 
 Prepare and present insurance quotations and renewal terms. 
 Work closely with underwriters and insurer partners to secure appropriate cover. 
 Ensure all documentation and client records are maintained accurately and in line with Central Bank regulations. 
 Maintain a high level of technical knowledge across commercial insurance products and market developments. 
 Support colleagues and contribute to the continued growth of the commercial team. 
 
  About You  
 
 Previous experience in Commercial Insurance within a brokerage or insurer. 
 Strong knowledge of SME commercial insurance products including Property, Liability, Motor Fleet, Professional Indemnity and Commercial Combined. 
 Experience managing renewals, new business and client relationships. 
 Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills. 
 Highly organised with strong attention to detail. 
 Customer-focused with a proactive and solution-driven approach. 
 APA Commercial qualified as a minimum; CIP qualification desirable or working towards. 
 
  Benefits:  
 
 Competitive Salary commensurate with experience (Wages paid weekly) 
 Additional bonus and commission Structure 
 Hybrid option after probation/training 
 Company Pension scheme 
 Death in service benefit insurance plan 
 22 days annual leave 
 Examinations/further study sponsored where relevant to the role 
 Opportunity to enhance your career in multiple areas of the insurance industry 
 Sport and social events throughout the year. 
 
  Why Apply?  
 
 Build your career with a growing local insurance business. 
 Work closer with your customer 
 Quick decision making direct with management 
 Work as part of a close-knit team where your contribution matters. 
 Work in a welcoming town with a strong local business community. 
 Enjoy working outside the hustle and bustle of a major city. 
 Centrally located in Tipperary with easy access from surrounding towns. 
 Convenient road and rail connections, with the M8 motorway nearby. 
 Plenty of cafés, restaurants, shops and services close to the office 
 Access to nearby low-cost all-day car parking 
 
 If you're looking to join a growing brokerage where you can develop your career, work closely with clients and become part of a friendly, experienced team, we'd love to hear from you.

agency:frsrecruitment.com:commercial-sal.title: Commercial Sales Executive
agency:frsrecruitment.com:commercial-sal.description:
Commercial Sales Executive 
 The job is to find, win and deliver new commercial clients. 
  Key areas of responsibility:  
 
 Identify and target large private and public sector organisations with fleets, depots or offices, and build a pipeline across the island of Ireland. 
 Open conversations with fleet managers, facilities managers, finance and sustainability leads, and senior decision makers. 
 Run the full sales cycle: qualify the need, understand the fleet and sites, present a solution, price it, negotiate and close. 
 Work with the technical team to scope each site 
 Prepare proposals, tenders and presentations, including public sector procurement responses. 
 Advise clients on available grants and incentives 
 Hand each won client over to operations and stay involved as the account develops, so that sites can expand and clients renew. 
 Keep the CRM up to date with accurate forecasts, and report on pipeline and results. 
 
  Who are you:  
 We need a proven commercial seller with the technical aptitude to be credible with fleet managers and engineers. 
 
 A strong record in B2B commercial sales, ideally selling to fleet managers or into fleet, energy, facilities or other infrastructure-led markets. 
 A track record of winning new clients, not only managing existing accounts. 
 Experience of long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with large organisations. 
 Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills. 
 Self-driven and comfortable working with a high proportion of variable pay. 
 Willing to travel across the island of Ireland. Full clean driving licence. 
 Experience of public sector procurement and tenders. 
 An existing network among fleet managers and facilities teams in Ireland and Northern Ireland. 
 
 You must have a valid permission to work in Ireland and a full, clean driving licence

agency:frsrecruitment.com:digital-market.title: DIGITAL MARKETING COORDINATOR
agency:frsrecruitment.com:digital-market.description:
DIGITAL MARKETING COORDINATOR 
 We are currently working on an exciting opportunity for a Digital Marketing Coordinator to join the marketing team of a leading international organisation within the building and insulation industry. 
 This is a hands-on role where you will be responsible for developing, executing and optimising digital marketing initiatives that support wider marketing and commercial objectives. 
 You will have the opportunity to work autonomously while collaborating closely with local marketeers, web specialists, sales teams, IT and external digital marketing agencies. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Contribute to the development and implementation of the digital marketing strategy, translating business priorities into annual and campaign plans across web, email, social media and paid channels. 
 Lead the execution of digital marketing campaigns, working closely with marketing colleagues to understand product groups and local market requirements. 
 Monitor and evaluate campaign performance, using data and insights to optimise activity and allocate budgets effectively. 
 Work with internal stakeholders and external agencies to improve digital marketing performance. 
 Lead and contribute to projects focused on lead generation, lead nurturing and marketing automation. 
 Collaborate with sales, IT and other internal teams to deliver effective digital marketing initiatives. 
 Act as a hands-on digital marketing expert within the wider marketing organisation. 
 
 About You 
 We are looking for someone with: 
 
 A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field. 
 At least 3 years’ experience in digital marketing, performance marketing or content-focused roles. 
 Proven experience managing campaigns across multiple digital channels. 
 Strong knowledge of content marketing, marketing automation and digital analytics. 
 Experience managing digital marketing budgets and working with external agencies. 
 Strong organisational, analytical and stakeholder management skills. 
 Experience working within an international organisation and across multiple product groups would be an advantage. 
 Fluent English; additional European languages would be a plus. 
 
 The Opportunity 
 This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded digital marketer who enjoys working across multiple channels and wants to take ownership of digital campaigns within an international environment. 
   
 Interested?  Get in touch for more information or to discuss the opportunity confidentially.

agency:frsrecruitment.com:employment-cas.title: Employment Case Worker
agency:frsrecruitment.com:employment-cas.description:
Employment Caseworker required for our  Kilkenny office. 
  Monday-Friday 09:00-05:00  
  We are looking for candidates with strong customer service and administration experience.  
  ABOUT TURAS NUA  
 IPNES supports people who are over 12 months unemployed or employed part-time on low earnings, by providing intensive, targeted and personalised employment support services. The IPNES contract is delivered by Turas Nua, the Irish employability services provider. Turas Nua is wholly owned by FRS Network, an Irish cooperative social enterprise, which has been delivering services to Irish communities since 1980. 
   
  ABOUT DEPARTMENT  
 IPNES supports people who are over 12 months unemployed or employed part-time on low earnings, by providing intensive, targeted and personalised employment support services. The IPNES contract is delivered by Turas Nua, the Irish employability services provider. Turas Nua is wholly owned by FRS Network, an Irish cooperative social enterprise, which has been delivering services to Irish communities since 1980. 
   
       
  PURPOSE OF ROLE  
 As a caseworker, you will work with clients referred by the Department of Social Protection to IPNES. You will manage a caseload of clients, coordinating our internal support specialists and external organisations to provide a personalised, planned support service to each client, to help them gain sustainable employment. You will also provide each client with one-to-one advice and support to guide their progress towards employment. 
   
  PERSON PROFILE  
 
 A dynamic and adaptable person who can work in a fast-paced, client-focused and results driven environment. You will possess strong case management capabilities including, decision-making skills, relationship skills and problem-solving skills. 
 Able to build rapport and trust with clients and motivate them to own their journey and achieve change. 
 Highly self-motivated and able to work in an office and remotely as part of a team. 
 Able to provide individual support to each client based on their particular needs. This requires a high level of understanding, patience and empathy, active listening skills and the ability to navigate more difficult conversations/interactions with professionalism and sensitivity. 
 Able to deliver a high-quality service which creates positive outcomes for the individuals and the communities with which we work. 
 
     
  KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:  
 
 Develop and manage a robust case management plan for each client, working towards sustainable, full-time employment. 
 use our industry-leading assessment technology to identify the client’s goals, ambitions, and barriers to employment. Use the output from the assessment to inform a structured personal progression plan, agreed with the client. 
 Recognise hidden motivations and conflict when assessing clients’ job-readiness, in order to address these with appropriate support and interventions. 
 Provide coaching and mentoring to clients, including providing intensive job search support when the client is job ready. 
 Identify, structure, and recommend training solutions in consultation with in-house tutors, to meet the specific learning and training needs of clients. 
 Fast-track job-ready clients for immediate job interviews brokered by our Employer Services consultants. 
 Maintain strong knowledge of the local labour market. 
 Organise a daily schedule that includes face-to-face meetings, phone calls, online meetings, and email correspondence with clients and other service providers. 
 Work closely with local and national specialist services (e.g., training, literacy, housing, health) to assist the client in their journey towards employment. 
 Present and facilitate workshops and group-learning presentations to clients weekly. 
 Achieve daily and monthly contractual key performance indicator (KPI) targets, managing a caseload of clients; for example, time-bound contacts, assessments, and support activities. 
 Provide guidance

agency:frsrecruitment.com:enterprise-bus.description:

 Someone who enjoys the  chaos of a startup  and wants to help build

 Someone competitive, driven, and hungry to progress

 Competitive base salary + strong commission 
 
 
 Meaningful equity that grows with each round 
 
 
 Direct mentorship from AEs and leadership 
 
 
 A chance to move into AE as the team scales 
 
 
 A culture that rewards effort, honesty, and ambition 
 
 
 Being part of a company protecting global brands

agency:frsrecruitment.com:health-and-saf.title: Health and Safety Coordinator
agency:frsrecruitment.com:health-and-saf.description:
Health & Safety Coordinator   
   Location: Tipperary / Midlands  11-Month Fixed-Term Contract | Strong Potential for Permanency  Generous Salary Package   
  Our client, a well-established manufacturing company based in the Tipperary/Midlands region, is seeking an experienced Health & Safety Coordinator to join their team.  
  This is an initial 11-month fixed-term contract,  with strong potential for a permanent position for the right candidate.   
  Reporting to the HR Manager, you will support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of the company's Health & Safety management systems across the site.  
  Working closely with management, supervisors and employees, you will play a key role in promoting a strong safety culture, ensuring compliance with Irish Health & Safety legislation and maintaining a safe and proactive working environment.  
   Key Responsibilities   
 
  Support the implementation and continuous improvement of Health & Safety policies, procedures and systems.  
  Carry out regular workplace safety inspections and audits, identifying hazards and following up on corrective actions.  
  Assist with the preparation, review and maintenance of Risk Assessments, Safe Operating Procedures and Method Statements.  
  Monitor compliance with site Health & Safety procedures and escalate areas of concern where required.  
  Assist with the investigation of accidents, incidents, near misses and dangerous occurrences.

 About the Role 
 We are currently recruiting on behalf of our client for an experienced  Site Operations & Data Coordinator  to support operations across two healthcare sites. 
 This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organised, analytical and proactive individual who enjoys working with data, improving processes and supporting operational teams. 
 Working closely with Site Managers and senior management, you will be responsible for managing operational information, producing performance reports, identifying areas for improvement and ensuring processes are consistent and efficient across both locations. 
 This is a varied, hands-on role suited to someone who is confident working independently, solving problems and taking ownership of their work. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 
 Manage and maintain operational data across both sites, including staffing, attendance, training, compliance and performance. 
 
 
 Prepare weekly and monthly reports, KPI dashboards and performance summaries for management. 
 
 
 Analyse data to identify trends, discrepancies and areas requiring improvement. 
 
 
 Ensure information is accurate, up to date and recorded correctly across different systems. 
 
 
 Review existing processes and recommend practical ways to improve efficiency and consistency across both locations. 
 
 
 Develop and maintain reporting templates, trackers, procedures and operational records.

 Ensure GDPR and confidentiality requirements are maintained. 
 
 
 What We're Looking For 
  Essential Requirements:  
 
 
 Minimum 5 years' experience in operations coordination, data management, reporting, business support or a similar role. 
 
 
 Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas, lookups, charts and data validation. 
 
 
 Strong Microsoft 365 skills and confidence working across different digital systems. 
 
 
 Previous experience preparing management reports, KPI dashboards and analysing operational data. 
 
 
 Ability to identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements to existing processes. 
 
 
 Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail. 
 
 
 Confident communicator who can work effectively with managers and different departments. 
 
 
 Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet deadlines. 
 
 
 A proactive, solutions-focused approach to work. 
 
 
  Desirable:  
 
 
 Experience using Power BI or other reporting tools. 
 
 
 Experience supporting digital transformation or process improvement projects.

agency:collinsmcnicholas.ie:customer-ser.title: Customer Service & Warehouse Administrator
agency:collinsmcnicholas.ie:customer-ser.description:
We are recruiting a Customer Service & Warehouse Administrator for a client in Dublin 15. The role combines customer support, order processing and warehouse administration. 
You will coordinate stock and logistics while keeping customers informed and orders moving. 
 Location:  Dublin 15  Hours:  Monday to Friday, 8 am–5 pm 

   Responsibilities:   

 
	 
	 Process customer orders and respond to queries. 
	
	 
	 Build relationships with new and existing customers. 
	
	 
	 Monitor stock levels and coordinate logistics bookings. 
	
	 
	 Liaise with colleagues on orders, stock and deliveries. 
	
	 
	 Maintain accurate records in SAP and other systems. 
	
	 
	 Prepare regular customer reports. 
	
	 
	 Assist with stock control and goods-in and goods-out activities. 
	
 

   Skills and experience:   

 
	 
	 Two to three years’ experience in a similar role. 
	
	 
	 Strong customer service, communication and organisational skills. 
	
	 
	 Experience with SAP or a similar ERP system. 
	
	 
	 Good working knowledge of Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint and Word. 
	
	 
	 A proactive approach to solving problems and improving service. 
	
 

   Benefits:   

 
	 
	 Pension Scheme 
	
	 
	 Access to a group health insurance plan following successful completion of probation. 
	
	 
	 20 days’ annual leave, rising to 21 days after two years’ service, 22 days after three years and 23 days after five years 
	  

	 For more information or a confidential discussion about this  Customer Service & Warehouse Administrator role,  contact Michelle Miley at  090 6450667  or via email at  michelle.miley@collinsmcnicholas.ie

agency:collinsmcnicholas.ie:global-npd-p.title: Global NPD Project Manager
agency:collinsmcnicholas.ie:global-npd-p.description:
We are partnering with a manufacturing client in  Athenry, Galway  who are looking to hire an experienced  Project Manager to join its Global NPD team  and lead complex projects through to commercial launch. 

 This is a broad, cross-functional role with responsibility for coordinating product development activity across multiple functions and product categories.  

  Responsibilities  

 
	 Lead end-to-end NPD projects from concept through to commercialisation and launch.
	 Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering engineering, regulatory, quality, supply chain and commercial activities.
	 Coordinate cross-functional teams and ensure accountability for key milestones and deliverables.
	 Manage project timelines, critical paths, risks, dependencies and scope changes. Provide clear project updates to senior stakeholders and proactively escalate issues or resource constraints.
	 Coordinate regulatory and quality requirements alongside product development timelines.
	 Support stage-gate reviews and ensure appropriate documentation and decision-making.
	 Coordinate launch readiness and the transition of new products into ongoing operations.
	 Manage supplier, regulatory and post-launch changes where required.
	 Occasional travel, up to approximately 10%.
 

  Requirements  

 
	 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, Business or a related discipline.
	 5+ years’ experience managing complex, cross-functional product development projects.
	 Experience within a regulated industry such as medical devices, pharmaceuticals, supplements, cosmetics or a similar environment.
	 Strong understanding of NPD and design control processes.
	 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple functions and levels.
	 PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent qualification would be an advantage.
 
 

  For a confidential discussion, a more detailed job spec and more information on the role, please contact Amy Newell.  

  amy.newell@collinsmcnicholas.ie  

  091-706718

agency:collinsmcnicholas.ie:hr-business-.title: HR Business Partner
agency:collinsmcnicholas.ie:hr-business-.description:
Our client, a world leading organisation based in Sligo are looking to add a Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) who partners with business leaders to develop and implement people strategies that drive business performance, employee engagement, organisational effectiveness, and a positive workplace culture. 

 Working closely with leaders across a dynamic manufacturing environment, the HRBP provides strategic and operational HR support across employee relations, talent management, organisational development, workforce planning, performance management, change management, and employee engagement. The role acts as a trusted advisor and coach to leaders, ensuring the consistent application of HR policies, employment legislation, and company values while supporting the achievement of business objectives. 

 The HRBP leverages HR data and insights to identify trends, develop solutions, and lead initiatives that enhance organisational capability, employee experience, and operational performance. 

   

  MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES  

 Reporting to the HR Manager, the incumbent will deliver the HR Value Proposition and have responsibility for the following: 

  Strategic Business Partner  

 
	 Partner with business leaders to understand business priorities and translate these into effective people strategies and workforce plans.
	 Provide strategic HR guidance and solutions that support organisational objectives and operational performance.
	 Utilise HR metrics, workforce analytics, and business insights to identify trends, recommend actions, and influence decision-making.
 

  Leadership Coaching & Support  

 
	 Act as a trusted advisor and coach to leaders, supporting their development and enhancing team and organisational effectiveness.
	 Build leadership capability through coaching, feedback, and guidance on people management best practices.
	 Support leaders in navigating complex people challenges and organisational change.
 

  Employee & Industrial Relations  

 
	 Provide expert guidance and support on employee relations matters, including disciplinary, grievance, performance management, attendance management, workplace investigations, and conflict resolution.
	 Coach and support managers to effectively manage employee relations issues while ensuring consistency, fairness, and compliance with company policies and employment legislation.
	 Promote positive employee relations and engagement across the organisation.
	 Identify ER trends and recommend proactive interventions to minimise risk and improve employee experience.
 

  Talent & Organisational Capability  

 
	 Partner with leaders to identify current and future talent requirements and develop robust succession and talent plans.
	 Support recruitment, talent development, succession planning, and career development initiatives.
	 Facilitate talent reviews and provide guidance on performance management and employee development processes.
 

  Culture, Engagement & Change  

 
	 Champion the organisation's culture, values, and employee experience initiatives.
	 Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, inclusion, retention, and organisational effectiveness.
	 Lead and support change management initiatives to ensure successful adoption of business and organisational changes.
 

  HR Operations & Continuous Improvement  

 
	 Support the delivery of core HR processes, including performance management, compensation review cycles, workforce planning, and organisational changes.
	 Ensure HR systems and employee data are maintained accurately and in compliance with data protection requirements.
	 Lead and participate in HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service delivery and employee experience.
	 Develop and deliver training, workshops, and people management programmes as required.
 

  EDUCATION & COMPETENCIES  

 
	 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related discipline.
	 CIPD qualification or membership (or equivalent

Position Title: Quality Engineer  Location: Athlone, Co. Westmeath  3–4 years experience   About the Role   Seeking a motivated and experienced Quality Engineer to join our team in Athlone. This is an excellent opportunity for a Quality Engineer with 3–4 years of experience to develop their career within a highly regulated medical device manufacturing environment. The successful candidate will support the maintenance and continuous improvement of our Quality Management System while working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Regulatory and other cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of quality systems, problem-solving methodologies and manufacturing processes, together with practical experience working within an FDA-regulated medical device environment.    Key Responsibilities 
 
 Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) in compliance with FDA requirements, ISO 13485 and applicable standards and regulations. 
 Lead and support quality activities including root cause analysis, CAPA, NCRs, change control and risk management. 
 Investigate Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), ensuring effective root cause analysis, corrective actions and timely closure. 
 Support CAPA development, implementation and effectiveness monitoring. 
 Support internal and external audits, including preparation, audit responses and follow-up actions. 
 Collaborate with Manufacturing and Engineering to resolve quality issues and drive continuous process improvement. 
 Support product and process risk assessments, process validation, equipment qualification and other quality-related manufacturing activities. 
 Review and maintain QMS documentation, including procedures, work instructions, inspection records and related quality records. 
 Support supplier quality activities, including supplier issues, corrective actions and quality performance monitoring. 
 Support change control for product and process changes, ensuring quality requirements are addressed. 
 Analyse quality data and trends to identify improvement opportunities and prevent recurring issues. 
 Promote a strong quality and continuous improvement culture across the organisation. 
 
 Qualifications & Experience  
 
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a Science or Manufacturing-related Engineering discipline, Biomedical Engineering, Quality, Science or a related field. Candidates should have strong practical experience in Medical Device Quality Management Systems (QMS). 
 3–4 years’ experience in a Quality Engineering, Quality Assurance or similar role within a regulated manufacturing environment. 
 Previous experience within the medical device industry is highly desirable. 
 Practical experience with FDA Quality System requirements is essential. 
 Good understanding and practical application of ISO 13485. 
 Experience with CAPA, NCRs, root cause analysis, change control, risk management and audits. 
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate quality issues and identify effective corrective actions. 
 Good understanding of manufacturing processes and quality control principles. 
 Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple quality activities effectively. 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 
 Good to Have   The following would be considered an advantage but are not essential requirements for the role: 
 
 Knowledge or experience of EU MDR requirements. 
 Knowledge of SPC, statistical analysis and quality improvement methodologies. 
 Knowledge of process validation and equipment qualification. 
 Knowledge or exposure to supplier quality management. 
 Knowledge of cleanroom or controlled manufacturing environments. 
 Lean Six Sigma or other recognised quality-related qualification. 
 Experience using quality and data analysis software such as Minitab, Q-Pulse or equivalent systems.

It's a real opportunity to put your own stamp on how quality is led here.      It's also a genuine career move. You'll report to the Group Head of Quality, Regulatory Affairs and Pharmacovigilance, and this role is seen as the succession pipeline into that group-level position. For the right person, there's a clear path to the top table. Oversee document management, change control, deviations, CAPA, complaints, supplier quality, training and management review.            Lead the rollout, optimisation and governance of a new electronic QMS as the site moves from paper to digital. Regulatory Compliance & Inspection Readiness       Keep the site compliant with EU GMP, GDP, ICH, FDA and other global requirements, with FDA readiness a key priority.            Front a busy inspection calendar as the lead quality representative: 30 to 40 customer audits and 3 to 5 regulatory inspections a year, including HPRA, FDA and auth

This is a key role within the Projects Team, taking responsibility for the day-to-day coordination of labour across multiple projects and sites. You'll work closely with the Operations Director and Project Directors to ensure the right people are in the right place at the right time, while acting as an important link between the office and field-based teams.  The position would particularly suit an experienced  HVAC professional  who understands the demands of a busy mechanical contracting environment and enjoys organising people, solving problems and keeping operations running smoothly. A strong understanding of mechanical services and project-based environments.    Experience coordinating labour, resources or field-based teams.    Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.    Strong organisational, planning and problem-solving abilities.    The confidence to manage changing priorities in a busy operational environment.    The ability to work independently and take ownership of day-to-day issues.    Good Microsoft Office skills.    A full clean driving licence.    Experience within an ISO-accredited environment would be beneficial, as would strong commercial awareness and an understanding of the operational demands of a mechanical contracting business.  Why Consider This Opportunity?  This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced HVAC professional looking to take on a  highly visible and influential operational position . You'll be joining an established business where your HVAC knowledge, operational judgement and ability to communicate with people at all levels will be genuinely valued. agency:engagepeople.ie:14707-financial-s.description:
If you’re looking to build a long-term career in Financial Services, this is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a client-focused environment while developing strong administrative and technical skills. 
 
 You’ll join an established financial services organisation where you’ll work closely with experienced advisers and supportive managers, gain valuable client exposure, and have the opportunity to progress your knowledge through further study and professional qualifications. The role is based onsite in modern Dublin offices. 
 
 The role 
 As Client Services Administrator, you’ll play an important part in supporting advisers and clients across pensions, investments and life assurance. You’ll manage client cases from application through to completion while ensuring records, documentation and regulatory requirements are handled accurately. 
 
 
 Manage client documentation and keep records accurate and up to date. 
 Prepare and process client application forms on behalf of advisers. 
 Manage new business cases across pensions, investments and life assurance. 
 Track applications from initial submission through to policy issue. 
 Liaise with clients, advisers, internal teams and external providers by phone and email. 
 Keep clients updated on applications and help resolve day-to-day queries. 
 Support AML, KYC and other compliance requirements when processing business. 
 Provide wider administrative and operational support across the team. 
 
 Is this you? 
 
 You’re organised, detail-focused and comfortable managing competing priorities in a busy environment. 
 You communicate confidently with clients and colleagues and enjoy delivering a high standard of service. 
 You are currently studying towards the Professional Diploma in Financial Advice (QFA), or are willing to actively work towards the qualification. Previous experience in financial planning or financial services would be an advantage. 
 
 What’s on offer 
 
 An opportunity to grow your career within Financial Services. 
 Direct exposure to clients, advisers and a range of financial products. 
 The chance to strengthen your administration, case-management and technical knowledge. 
 Support for continued learning and professional study. 
 Experienced and supportive managers who can help you develop within the organisation. 
 Modern office environment. 
 On-site working model. 
 Salary and benefits are not being disclosed at this stage. 
 
 How to apply 
 To find out more, reach out to  Michael Gorman  or apply with your CV below. 
 Engage People is a multi-award-winning recruitment agency. We specialise across Accountancy, Financial Services, Technology, and Real Estate. To learn more about how we help create winning partnerships between professionals and organisations, get in touch today.
